_about: Which species may be made as a physical figurine. Jake decided (Nov 24 2026): the game's own pets are the product (Pepe, Bobo, Dodo and the rest), so every game species is ok. stop = based on a real person or a big TV franchise: the tool will not make a print file unless run with --allow-stop. ask = shows a reminder on the order sheet. A hybrid takes the strictest level of its parents. Species not listed count as ask. Edit this file to change it.
